title: Family Matters
subtitle: Aprender a hablar sobre la familia.

tl: Hi! Nice to meet you. Do you have family here?
Yes, I have family here. My mum and dad live in Camden.
That's lovely! How many of you are there?
We are four. I have a brother and a sister.
es: Sí, tengo familia aquí. Mi mamá y papá viven en Camden.
Somos cuatro. Tengo un hermano y una hermana.
